title: IoT Weather Web Server Beacon
tagline: Deploy a standalone internet HTTP server on an Arduino with W5100 SPI shield to serve live barometric weather data.

phases.instructions: Locate from your kit: Arduino Uno, W5100 Ethernet Shield (comp_30), BMP180 Barometric Pressure Sensor (comp_08), DHT11 Temp/Humidity Sensor (comp_09), RJ-45 LAN Ethernet cable, breadboard, and wires.
verificationCheckpoints: LAN cable connected to home router/switch

phases.instructions: Carefully press the W5100 Ethernet Shield onto the Arduino Uno headers. Connect BMP180 SDA/SCL to the shield's A4/A5 header pins. Connect DHT11 DATA to Pin 2.
verificationCheckpoints: Ethernet shield ICSP header fully seated
Sensors wired to pass-through headers on top of shield

phases.instructions: Plug in LAN cable: verify the green LINK LED and amber ACT LED illuminate on the shield's RJ-45 jack.
verificationCheckpoints: No bent pins on the shield stacking headers

phases.phaseTitle: Code Walkthrough & Embedded HTTP Web Server
phases.instructions: Review embedded HTTP server architecture: negotiates local IP via DHCP, listens on port 80, parses client GET requests, and streams an HTML5 live telemetry dashboard.
phases.codeExplanation:
- Ethernet.begin(mac) automatically acquires IP address from local home router via DHCP.
- server.available() intercepts web browser TCP connections on port 80.
- Sends standard HTTP 200 OK headers followed by semantic HTML markup.
- Browser displays live updating weather dashboard from any computer, tablet, or phone on the LAN.
verificationCheckpoints: Understand DHCP local IP address leasing

phases.phaseTitle: Upload & Web Browser Live Dashboard Test
phases.instructions: Upload sketch. Open Serial Monitor to see the assigned IP address. Open Chrome or Safari on your phone or laptop, type the IP into the URL bar, and watch your Arduino serve live weather telemetry!
verificationCheckpoints: Serial Monitor reports valid local IP (e.g. 192.168.1.xxx)
Web browser displays live HTML5 weather page with 5-second auto-refresh

phases.instructions: IoT Architect Master! You deployed a fully standalone HTTP internet server on an embedded microcontroller.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim IoT Architect badge

variants.title: RESTful JSON Telemetry Endpoint
variants.description: Serve structured JSON payloads (/api/telemetry) instead of HTML for mobile app consumption.
variants.codeAdaptation: Inspect HTTP request line for '/api/telemetry'; output Content-Type: application/json and raw JSON

extensionMissions.title: Remote Relay Actuation via Web
extensionMissions.objective: Parse HTTP POST or GET /relay/on and /relay/off requests to remotely trigger physical lab equipment.
hints: If matched, digitalWrite(RELAY_PIN, HIGH) and output status page

story: Bring your Monster Lab online to the global internet! Mount the W5100 SPI Ethernet shield, connect a LAN cable, and host an interactive micro-web server that serves live atmospheric temperature, barometric pressure, and altitude to any browser on your network.

troubleshooting.symptom: DHCP Failed error in Serial Monitor
troubleshooting.cause: LAN cable disconnected or router blocked DHCP lease
troubleshooting.solution: Check RJ-45 cable connection to router, or specify a static IP address using Ethernet.begin(mac, ip).
diagnosticSteps: Verify green link LED on Ethernet shield jack
Test LAN cable with a laptop to verify active internet
